id: title:adamleithp:add a view all row and smarter ask ai question

review.posthog_relevance: Changes to the CommandK search and query execution interface, including the addition of a 'skeleton' loading state, a new AI question generation function, and a 'View all' results function, alongside supporting tests and documentation.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement. P1.F3.H2 and P1.F4.H2 show the implementation of a skeleton loading state and the removal of inline rendering, which could improve perceived performance and accessibility. review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the implementation of the removed actions and the complete implementation of the new selectors and row types, which prevents assigning a higher tier. The chunk is frontend-only, and the backend, API, and test execution are not supplied, which could affect the overall impact and reliability of the change.

observations.behavior: Adds a 'skeleton' row kind and its rendering, while removing the inline skeleton rendering from CommandKSearchSection. P1.F3.H3 adds a conditional check for row.kind === 'skeleton' and returns a Skeleton component. P1.F3.H2 adds a case for 'skeleton' returning null. P1.F4.H2 removes the inline skeleton rendering and relies on the row kind instead.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a skeleton loading state for the CommandKSearch component, potentially improving perceived performance and accessibility. The removal of inline skeleton rendering could also reduce unnecessary DOM updates.
